answer: Sybil pressure grows when cheap clones share one vault and skim the same reward pool. Mechanism: each new identity posts a 0.8-unit bond into a terrace escrow for 3 epochs, and a lantern attestation graph must show 5 distinct non-kin verifiers before the bond unlocks; clones that reuse vault_pub fail the graph and forfeit. Cost: ~0.8 unit locked plus ~6 attest messages. Verification: escrow release checks verifier set size, non-kin BFS<=2, and unique vault_pub. Failure: if verifiers drop below 5 or a kin edge appears, the bond burns and the fable of easy multiplicity ends.
